## Dual-channel notify helper
Called by **Execute Workflow** with `{ userId, phone, email, message, subject?, scenario?, channelPref?, ctaUrl?, … }`.

Sends via paystack-api `POST /api/internal/notify` (email preferred, SMS fallback; pass `channels: ['sms','email']` to force both).

YKW 02/03/04/journeys already notify inline — this helper is optional for shared calls.

Env on **n8n**: `YAKWETU_API_URL`, `INTERNAL_API_KEY` (or `ADMIN_TOKEN`).
Resend/AT live on **paystack-api**.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ userId: $json.userId, phone: $json.phone || '', email: $json.email || '', name: $json.name || '', channelPref: $json.channelPref || 'both', subject: $json.subject || 'Yakwetu Sinema', message: $json.message, scenario: $json.scenario || 'n8n_notify', sessionId: $json.sessionId || null, ctaUrl: $json.ctaUrl || $json.url || null, ctaLabel: $json.ctaLabel || null, imageUrl: $json.imageUrl || null, filmTitle: $json.filmTitle || null, bundleTitle: $json.bundleTitle || null, genre: $json.genre || null, priceKes: $json.priceKes || null, discountPct: $json.discountPct || null, watchedTitle: $json.watchedTitle || null, headline: $json.headline || null, badge: $json.badge || null }) }}
